evidence.excerpt: Department of Planning and Permitting City and County of Honolulu Honolulu, Hawaii
design of storm drainage facilities in the City and County of Honolulu
This edition supersedes the Rules Relating to Storm Drainage Standards, January 2000 (Repealed August 16, 2017).
These standards have been prepared pursuant to Article 12, Chapter 14, Revised Ordinances of Honolulu, 1990 as amended
For drainage areas of 100 acres or less, Tm (recurrence interval) = 10 years, unless otherwise specified.
For drainage areas of 100 acres or less with sump, or tailwater effect and for the design of roadway culverts and bridges, Tm (recurrence interval) = 50 years.
For drainage areas greater than 100 acres and all streams... Tm (recurrence interval) = 100 years.
For drainage areas of 100 acres or less, the rational method shall be used.
The formula Q = CIA shall be used to determine quantities of flow rate
Plate 6 titled, "Design Curves for Peak Discharge vs. Drainage Area" should be used to determine the 100-year peak discharge.
C. CLOSED CONDUITS... D. OPEN CHANNELS

New development and redevelopment projects shall also comply with the requirements in the Rules Relating to Water Quality to implement low impact development best management practices to reduce discharge of pollutants into the final receiving waters.

extraction_quality.review_notes: Conveyance/hydrologic standards only. Water quality volume and LID BMP sizing are deferred to separate Rules Relating to Water Quality (not in this PDF).
